oliver_exec: :loudspeaker: Launching Private data-residency self-attestation pilot + export-control onboarding for on-prem customers. Pilot starts 2026-07-01. Docs: https://go.redwood/onprem-self-attest
ria_compliance: TL;DR for customer comms:
ria_compliance: • Customers in certain jurisdictions must complete a short self-attestation to declare data residency and export restrictions.
ria_compliance: • Pilot offers a guided checklist + automated artifact bundle generator (customer controlled) for audit evidence.
henry_eng: Technical notes:
henry_eng: • Artifact bundle is a ZIP with config hashes, agent version, and selected export-control flags (NO PLAINTEXT DATA).
henry_eng: • Customers run locally; nothing leaves the environment unless explicitly uploaded with consent.
henry_eng: CLI example:
henry_eng: ```
redwoodctl attest residency --region eu-west-1 --export-controls yes --generate-bundle ./bundle.zip
```
lina_support: Support offering:
lina_support: • Free assisted attest for pilot customers (one-time) with a review report.
lina_support: • Ongoing assisted attestation will be a paid add-on after the pilot.
sai_sales: Sales one-liner: "Complete the Redwood Private Self-Attestation to verify residency & export settings; opt-in assisted review available for accelerated onboarding."
legal_exports: Legal note: export-control answers are customer-provided. For regulated workloads route to legal@redwood.com for a compliance agreement. Certain capabilities require an Export Appendix before enabling.
ops-bot: Pilot created: PRIVATE-ATTEST-2026-4071209999 assigned to lina_support (due 2026-09-01)
oliver_exec: Timeline:
oliver_exec: • 2026-07-01: Pilot begins (invite-only, up to 15 customers)
oliver_exec: • 2026-08-15: Collect feedback + iterate bundle format
oliver_exec: • 2026-09-01: Evaluate GA readiness and pricing model
henry_eng: Data handling assurance: bundle contains metadata and hashes only. If customers opt to upload, the upload flow requires a signed consent token and an upload TTL.
henry_eng: Upload CLI snippet:
henry_eng: ```
redwoodctl attest upload ./bundle.zip --consent "export-review" --ttl 7d
```
ria_compliance: Outreach plan: compliance will contact eligible customers this week and include a short decision tree for AEs.
sai_sales: Please add a simple slide for the AE playbook with the decision tree and the sales one-liner.
lina_support: I'll add the playbook and schedule a training session for support this Thu.
legal_exports: Note re: sanctions screening — we will not enable export-related features for accounts failing sanctions checks until resolved. Route escalations to legal_exports.
oliver_exec: Thanks everyone. Docs + customer FAQ will land by EOD tomorrow. If no objections we'll publish the pilot invite page and start outreach.
ria_compliance: No objections from compliance. :white_check_mark:
henry_eng: No objections from eng; will deliver bundle generator and CLI hooks by 2026-06-25.
lina_support: Confirmed for training slot Thu.
ops-bot: Announcement published: <https://go.redwood/onprem-self-attest|onprem-self-attest> by @oliver_exec at 4071209999
sai_sales: End of thread — thanks! :raised_hands:
